name: Hermes Jev Skills
notes: The repository holds thirteen SKILL.md skills, an install.py installer for Hermes, Claude Code and Codex, the jevkit package, evals and a router dashboard. The computer-use skill bundles coagent_cu.py and jev_gui_agent.py (cua-driver over MCP on macOS); the browser skill bundles jev_browser_agent.py, which wraps Jev Ultrafast under a host allowlist and step budget. Jev calls use a TypeSafe API key; declared license MIT.
summary: SKILL.md skills for Hermes, Claude Code and Codex agents that pass small decisions to the Jev model, including desktop and browser skills in which Jev picks each next action from a caller-built table.
